entries.title: Proverbs 24:1
segments: ¶Be not thou envious of evil men, neither desire to be with them;

entries.title: Proverbs 24:2
segments: for their heart studieth destruction, and their lips talk of mischief.

entries.title: Proverbs 24:3
segments: ¶Through wisdom is a house built, and by understanding it is established;

entries.title: Proverbs 24:4
segments: and by knowledge are the chambers filled with all precious and pleasant substance.

entries.title: Proverbs 24:5
segments: A wise man is strong, and a man of knowledge increaseth strength.

entries.title: Proverbs 24:6
segments: For with good advice shalt thou make thy war; and in the multitude of counsellors there is safety.

entries.title: Proverbs 24:7
segments: ¶Wisdom is too high for a fool: he will not open his mouth in the gate.

entries.title: Proverbs 24:8
segments: He that deviseth to do evil shall be called a master of intrigues.

entries.title: Proverbs 24:9
segments: The purpose of folly is sin, and the scorner is an abomination to men.

entries.title: Proverbs 24:10
segments: ¶[If] thou losest courage in the day of trouble, thy strength is small.

entries.title: Proverbs 24:11
segments: ¶Deliver them that are taken forth unto death, and withdraw not from them that stagger to slaughter.

entries.title: Proverbs 24:12
segments: If thou sayest, Behold, we knew it not, will not he that weigheth the hearts consider it? And he that preserveth thy soul, he knoweth it; and he rendereth to man according to his work.

entries.title: Proverbs 24:13
segments: ¶Eat honey, my son, for it is good; and a honeycomb is sweet to thy taste:

entries.title: Proverbs 24:14
segments: so consider wisdom for thy soul; if thou hast found it, there shall be a result, and thine expectation shall not be cut off.

entries.title: Proverbs 24:15
segments: ¶Lay not wait, O wicked [man], against the dwelling of the righteous; lay not waste his resting-place.

entries.title: Proverbs 24:16
segments: For the righteous falleth seven times, and riseth up again; but the wicked stumble into disaster.

entries.title: Proverbs 24:17
segments: ¶Rejoice not when thine enemy falleth, and let not thy heart be glad when he stumbleth;

entries.title: Proverbs 24:18
segments: lest Jehovah see it, and it be evil in his sight, and he turn away his anger from him.

entries.title: Proverbs 24:19
segments: ¶Fret not thyself because of evil-doers, [and] be not envious of the wicked:

entries.title: Proverbs 24:20
segments: for there shall be no future to the evil [man]; the lamp of the wicked shall be put out.

entries.title: Proverbs 24:21
segments: ¶My son, fear Jehovah and the king: meddle not with them that are given to change.

entries.title: Proverbs 24:22
segments: For their calamity shall rise suddenly; and who knoweth the ruin of them both?

entries.title: Proverbs 24:23
segments: ¶These things also come from the wise. It is not good to have respect of persons in judgment.

entries.title: Proverbs 24:24
segments: He that saith unto the wicked, Thou art righteous, peoples shall curse him, nations shall abhor him;

entries.title: Proverbs 24:25
segments: but to them that rebuke [him] shall be delight, and a good blessing cometh upon them.

entries.title: Proverbs 24:26
segments: He kisseth the lips who giveth a right answer.

entries.title: Proverbs 24:27
segments: ¶Prepare thy work without, and put thy field in order, and afterwards build thy house.

entries.title: Proverbs 24:28
segments: ¶Be not a witness against thy neighbour without cause; and wouldest thou deceive with thy lips?

entries.title: Proverbs 24:29
segments: Say not, I will do so to him as he hath done to me, I will render to the man according to his work.

entries.title: Proverbs 24:30
segments: ¶I went by the field of a sluggard, and by the vineyard of a man void of understanding;

entries.title: Proverbs 24:31
segments: and lo, it was all grown over with thistles, and nettles had covered the face thereof, and its stone wall was broken down.

entries.title: Proverbs 24:32
segments: Then I looked, I took it to heart; I saw, I received instruction:

entries.title: Proverbs 24:33
segments: --A little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to rest!

entries.title: Proverbs 24:34
segments: So shall thy poverty come [as] a roving plunderer, and thy penury as an armed man.
